scope: Families and datasets are reference entries, not installed environments. Reference-only integrations are unimplemented and untested in this workbench.

items.name: Stationary Bernoulli bandit
protocol_requirements: Pin arm means, horizon and independent RNG streams.
Evaluate all online rewards; track optimal-action rate only if available as isolated diagnostics.
caveats: A teaching environment with no general benchmark standing.

items.name: Hidden-switch Bernoulli bandit
protocol_requirements: Pin the exogenous switching schedule before execution.
Keep phase labels outside learner input; preserve action/reward history continuously.
Report lifetime mean reward and prespecified post-change windows.
caveats: A controlled nonstationarity diagnostic, not a complete continual-RL benchmark.

items.name: Local cliff grid
protocol_requirements: Pin map, start/goal, cliff penalty and transition/reset semantics.
Separate training behavior from frozen greedy evaluation.
caveats: Locally implemented teaching variant; do not claim byte-for-byte Gymnasium equivalence.

items.name: Gymnasium CartPole-v1
protocol_requirements: Pin Gymnasium version and wrappers.
Distinguish termination from time-limit truncation and log the final observation.
caveats: Initial optional scope is SB3 PPO only; CartPole smoke success does not validate deep-RL research claims.

items.name: Exact finite-MDP diagnostics
protocol_requirements: Publish transition/reward tables and analytically derived expectations.
Keep oracle model information out of algorithms that are meant to learn from transitions.
caveats: A task specification pattern, not a supplied simulator.

items.name: Random walk prediction
protocol_requirements: Declare start-state distribution, absorbing states and reward placement.
Compare estimated values to exact solutions under a fixed evaluation distribution.
caveats: Prediction RMSE does not measure control return.

items.name: Baird-style off-policy divergence diagnostic
protocol_requirements: Pin features, target/behavior policies and sampling weights.
Record parameter norm and prediction error as diagnostics.
caveats: Failure or success on one counterexample is not a universal convergence result.

items.name: Gymnasium continuous/classic control family
protocol_requirements: Use exact environment IDs and package versions.
Declare wrappers, action scaling, time limits, reward transformations and physical perturbations.
caveats: Names such as Ant or Pendulum alone do not specify a reproducible task.

items.name: Arcade Learning Environment
protocol_requirements: Pin ALE/ROM hashes and license/access requirements.
Declare sticky actions, frame skip, life-loss treatment, frame stacking and frame/decision budget.
Report per-game distributions and prespecified aggregation.
caveats: ROMs are not included; task preprocessing materially changes the protocol.

items.name: MinAtar
protocol_requirements: Pin game version, difficulty and action conventions.
State whether simplified observations and sticky actions are enabled.
caveats: Simplified games provide a cheaper development setting, not direct ALE equivalence.

items.name: Procgen
protocol_requirements: Lock train/test level distributions, level counts and difficulty.
Separate training-set reuse from unseen-level generalization.
caveats: A larger number of episodes on seen levels is not evidence of new-level generalization.

items.name: Behaviour Suite
protocol_requirements: Preserve the exact bsuite_id settings and prescribed episode budget.
Use capability-specific plots alongside aggregate scores.
caveats: The dm_env discount/last interface needs an explicit adapter; no adapter is supplied here.

items.name: DeepMind Control Suite
protocol_requirements: Pin domain/task, physics/control timestep, observation mode and wrappers.
Translate LAST and discount deliberately; count physics versus agent steps.
caveats: dm_env and Gymnasium termination semantics cannot be equated by position alone.

items.name: Minari offline datasets
protocol_requirements: Pin dataset ID/version/hash, collection policy and preprocessing.
Keep environment reconstruction separate from dataset reuse.
caveats: This is an offline-data registry/ecosystem, not one environment; no dataset is downloaded.

items.name: Forager
protocol_requirements: Pin map size, observation aperture, objects, regeneration and changing reward rules.
Preserve continuing start/step semantics; an evaluation window is not an environmental reset.
Log the complete lifetime and memory cost.
caveats: The native interface does not emit a termination flag; any episodic wrapper changes the protocol.
No Forager adapter or implementation qualification is included.

items.name: AgarCL
protocol_requirements: Pin environment/baseline revisions, opponent rules, action interfaces and observation mode.
Declare death/rebirth effects on every learner state.
Keep frozen evaluation separate from native online performance.
caveats: Rebirth need not reset learned parameters or memory; benchmark settings must specify the distinction.
No AgarCL adapter or long-horizon experiment is included.

items.name: Continual World
protocol_requirements: Pin task sequence, order repetitions, training budgets and evaluation matrix.
Declare task IDs, boundary signals, heads, replay and reset rules.
caveats: Task-sequential results do not automatically transfer to boundary-free continuing learning.

items.name: COOM
protocol_requirements: Pin scenarios, task order, observation/action preprocessing and scenario budgets.
Record all exposed task/boundary information and policy reset rules.
caveats: Game/task-sequence evaluation and a single continuing lifetime answer different questions.

items.name: PettingZoo environment/API ecosystem
protocol_requirements: Choose an exact game/version and AEC or Parallel interface; the family ID is not runnable.
Pin order semantics, agent identity, dynamic membership, reward accumulation and per-agent terminal/truncation.
Declare any conversion wrapper, communication information and train/evaluation clocks.
caveats: No native MARL adapter is provided.
AEC and Parallel conversion requires specific update-cycle conditions; arbitrary conversion changes the game.
Moved environment families and modern API entry points require version-specific source checks.

items.name: SMACv2
protocol_requirements: Pin StarCraft II, maps, capability generator, team composition and observation/state configuration.
Declare centralized-state privileges, agent availability/death masks and reward scaling.
Separate training scenarios, test scenario distribution and independent team seeds.
caveats: No environment installation, game assets or MARL integration are included.
Procedurally new same-distribution scenarios do not automatically constitute out-of-distribution evaluation.
